svg.title: Experience and education
svg.desc: AI/ML Intern, Flexidigit Technologies (MAY 2026 – PRESENT): Architected a reusable multi-agent orchestration engine with CrewAI and n8n that automates an end-to-end production workflow. Built RAP, a recruitment automation platform where 9 AI agents read job posts, find candidates and rank them into a shortlist. Automated the recruiter pipeline from shortlist to interview to placement, verified by 111 automated tests. | R&D Intern, National Institute of Technology, Trichy (JUN 2025): Benchmarked energy-based anomaly detection against statistical thresholding baselines on time-series sleep data, across accuracy and false-positive rate. Profiled and optimized the NumPy inference pipeline, cutting latency by 30%, validated on held-out subject data. | Education: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering, SRM University, Chennai, AUG 2023 – MAY 2027 (EXPECTED), CGPA 9.68/10 | Co-founder & President, Synergy Club, SRM University (AUG 2025 – PRESENT): Grew a student tech club to 200+ members; run hackathons, coding workshops and hands-on AI/ML sessions. | Volunteer, Spastics Society, Trichy (JUN – JUL 2025): Taught basic computer literacy to differently-abled children and supported inclusion campaigns.
